Telangana Congress defers decision on Minister Konda Surekha amid controversy

The Telangana Congress leadership has postponed a decision regarding Minister Konda Surekha. This comes after an incident involving an attack on Revanth Reddy, with Surekha being identified as a figure in the controversy. The specific details of the incident and the nature of Surekha's involvement have not been elaborated upon in the provided coverage, but the leadership's deferral indicates a pause in addressing the matter.
